model: Wall Plate Series BACnet/Modbus temperature/RH sensor
applies_to: ACI Wall Plate Series stainless wall-plate temperature, RH and temperature/RH sensors with the BACnet MS/TP / Modbus RTU interface (guide I0000931).
summary: ACI's stainless wall-plate room sensor for temperature, humidity or both, with a DIP-switch selectable BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU RS-485 interface and no analog output. Readings are signed tenths in input registers; a few holding registers set units, offsets and user labels.

addressing.note: Each row gives a Reference (1-based, e.g. 3) and an Address (0-based, e.g. 2). The documented field here holds the Reference; the address field holds the Address column, which is what goes on the wire.

source.title: Wall Plate Series BACnet / Modbus User's Guide
source.pages: pp. 7-9 (interface, baud, EOL), p. 10 (address), p. 13 (framing, test mode), pp. 14-16 (Modbus RTU map)

notes: The map prints a 1-based Reference column and a 0-based Address column side by side (e.g. Reference 3 = Address 2 for the temperature value); this map uses the Address column.

RH values and RH range registers are described only as tenths of %RH without a sign statement; they are listed as unsigned since RH cannot be negative. The RH offset is explicitly allowed to be negative (example -16 = -1.6 %RH) so it is INT16.
Temperature registers carry no fixed unit: the unit follows holding register 0 (62 °C, 63 K, 64 °F).
Temperature-only models have no RH element and RH-only models no temperature element; input register 0 shows which is fitted.

registers.name: Test mode enable
registers.description: 1 = IR3/IR4 return the test values in HR1001/HR1002; not kept after reset.

registers.name: Temperature sensor value
registers.description: Tenths, in the unit chosen in HR1 (address 0).

registers.name: Temperature units
registers.description: Unit used for the temperature value and ranges.

registers.name: Temperature offset
registers.description: Added to the reading; -5.0 to 5.0 °C/K (-9.0 to 9.0 °F).

registers.name: RH offset
registers.description: Added to the RH reading; -10.0 to 10.0 %RH.

registers.name: Test mode temperature value
registers.description: Returned by IR3 while test mode is on.

registers.name: Test mode RH value
registers.description: Returned by IR4 while test mode is on.

integration.summary: Switch the sensor to Modbus with SW4 DIP 4, give it a non-zero address and a fixed baud rate, then read input registers 2 (temperature, tenths) and 3 (RH) with function 04. Check input registers 9000/9001 once to confirm your master decodes unsigned and signed values correctly.
integration.enable: SW4 DIP 4 ON selects Modbus RTU; address on switches 1-7 (must not be 0); baud on switches 8-10; power-cycle or press reset after any switch change.
quirks: Temperature unit is set by holding register 0, not fixed; values are tenths of that unit.
Test mode (coil 1000) substitutes HR1000/HR1001 values into the live registers and is cleared by reset or power cycle.
String registers: test string and user text are null terminated, serial number and firmware are not.
setup: Set SW4 DIP 4 ON to select Modbus (factory default is BACnet MS/TP), then power-cycle or press reset.
Set the address on switches 1-7 (binary, 1-127). Address 0 is the factory default and cannot be used with Modbus.
Set the baud rate on switches 8-10 (9600-115200); auto-baud does not work in Modbus mode.
SW4 PAR 2 / PAR 1 DIP switches (1 = ON) set framing: 0/0 8-E-1, 0/1 8-O-1, 1/0 8-N-2, 1/1 8-N-1.
Move the EOL jumper to EN on the last device of the RS-485 trunk (default DIS).
gotchas: The factory default is BACnet MS/TP with auto-baud; a sensor left at defaults will not answer Modbus.
8-None-1 framing is labelled non-standard by ACI.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
